checks.quote: Rescue fails to restore 50 kDa despite restored target expression.
checks.reason: Expression alone does not establish function, correct processing or epitope retention; a failed rescue is not necessarily a biological contradiction. Expected mass or a different protein in MS alone also cannot overturn the band identity.

checks.quote: direct identification would convert positional inference into molecular identity.
checks.reason: Gel/IP-MS detects present proteins, which may be co-migrants or associated partners. Co-migration with an endogenous tag is useful but does not by itself identify the antibody-bound antigen.

explanation_reason: Correct conditional main inference, but mass/peptide presence and failed-rescue outcomes are overstated.
